frame: three.js, Y up, mm. Node 'phone_stand' is the stand root: put it at the twin bench-top position (0, 0, -225). pivot_stand is in the phone_stand frame (informational); each moving node's origin is on its pivot.

pan.angle: node rotation about axis = mechanical pan (deg, CCW from above; 0 = rear camera toward +Z, the machine) = protocol pan + zero.pan

tilt.angle: node rotation about axis = camera elevation el (deg; 0 = phone upright, screen to the operator; -90 = rear camera straight down) = protocol tilt + zero.tilt

zero.note: protocol aim (0, 0) = rear camera on the deck centre (bed at machine y = 90). The GLB is modelled at mechanical pan 0, el 0.

print_up: glTF extras.print_up on each printed part node: unit print-direction (layer normal) in the node frame
